name: job-hunt-skills
description: Run a job search from a personal CV skills database: tailored ATS-safe CVs (PDF + DOCX), database upkeep, LinkedIn/ATS search filters, and recruiter replies.

data_dir.title: Job hunt data folder
data_dir.description: Folder with your personal data: config.md, cv-database/, cvs/ (generated CVs), job_descriptions/ and your search filters file. Start from the sample in this plugin's examples/data/. Keep it outside the plugin, e.g. in OneDrive or an Obsidian vault. Enter the path without quotes, even if it has spaces.
